nodes.text: at all, there he reviled him and said
he was a deceiver and a bad fisherman.
When this same messenger of the devil
came there, he performed many a miracle-like
sorcery. Where the heads stood carved
on the pillars, he made it so
that people thought they laughed.
Those he wished to hold fast, he held fast,
so that they could not move from the spot.
And he made himself invisible
and vanished from people out from under their
hands, and boasted that
he could indeed bring the dead to life; and
many other things he did which
seemed wondrous to people. Saint
Peter and Saint Paul were not
sent, the holy apostle, whose
day it is today. When he came there,
he went into a temple where an idol
was inside, which was called Astaroth.
The devil sat in a marble
pillar and had long
deceived the world, so that they believed it
was God, for they were all in the
devil's power through
unbelief. So, with the
devil's power, he did with them whatever he
wished, and made them deaf and
blind and dumb, and impaired them
in their limbs. When they then
worshipped him and made offerings to him,
he took from them the spell with
which he had disturbed their senses,
and then they became seeing
and hearing and speaking.
Because of that, foolish people believed
that he was God and worked
miracles. Thus he gave them answers
